_curation_notes: MVP insert pool — 6 Scryfall art_crops from the bundle's own cards as wide thesis-grounder panels, exclude rules so an art_crop never lands on the same page as its source card. Picks chosen for high visual narrative weight (the keystone Vampire Cleric flying through fog; the Holmes-Doyle deduction card; the framing-and-alibi pair; the chase scenes). Single-set bundle means inserts can lean on the set's own art language. DeviantArt thesis-art layer can be added later by dropping files into this dir.

Eliminate the Impossible — the Holmes-Doyle deduction. Carlos Palma Cruchaga.
Expose the Culprit — Agency × disguise. Ryan Valle.
Offender at Large — Foundway Associates × disguise. 'In a city this big, anyone can blend in.' Mike Bierek.
Caught Red-Handed — the wrongly-accused defendant's confession. Donato Giancola.
The Chase Is On — Kaya through the Manor. Diego Gisbert. Cross-bundle Kaya bridge to Discrete Lair 001 Tithe.
Crowd-Control Warden — Agency centaur with golden magical chains. Diego Gisbert. Visual echo of Secure the Scene's blue chains in Lair 001.
